results.content: *Project topic:* Development of advanced millimeter-wave circuits for 6G wireless networks and high-resolution radar systems. This research focuses on advancing millimeter-wave circuit design for frequencies above 100 GHz, aimed at developing next-generation 6G wireless networks and high-resolution radar systems. This project focuses on advancing power amplifier (PA) architectures and design methodologies to address critical challenges in modern wireless communication systems, including limited bandwidth, low efficiency under high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) signals, and performance degradation under load mismatch conditions. *Project topic:* Advanced optimization based on surrogate modeling and space mapping techniques for computationally efficient modeling and design optimization of coupled signal and power integrity (SI-PI) analysis of high-speed interconnects and power delivery networks. This project aims to apply techniques based on surrogate modeling and space mapping, to develop an advanced optimization methodology for modeling and design of coupled signal and power integrity analysis of high-speed interconnects and power delivery networks, with high precision and low computational cost.
